reconstruction.heightBasis: Mapped nominal heights20/24m and min_height20/24 to height34 for the two main domes; bell30m, eastern apse23m and western roof turret22m. All heights are relative to the common estimated native church floor0.75m. reconstruction.scope: Connected church exterior: two principal domes/drums, square bell tower, arched south facade/entrance court, mapped upper/low ranges, selected small cupolas/apse roofs and terrace stairs. Interior Aedicule/chapels, below-grade StHelena volume, separate east police range, surrounding city and exact sculpture remain excluded.
reconstruction.componentControlMethod: Union of all current standard PMTiles fragments for each selected ID; higher part footprints mask lower roof caps. Interior/underground and separate east range are excluded from visible reconstruction.

geographicProposal.reviewStatus: Approximate church exterior and source-terrain fit reviewed against two inspected roof/facade pictures and standard viewer PMTiles/DEM. Untagged levels/roles, precise street/church datum and walking collision remain unverified exterior estimates.

terrainReference.basis: NativeY0 follows retained standard viewer DEM770.4363m at anchor. Estimated0.75m church/court floor, range foundations and terrace levels are exterior approximations against coarse sloping ground.

geographicProposal.notes: Exact-QID outline/current main and part polygons, mapped dome/bell height intervals and south entrance court establish approximate scale and signed facing. Untagged levels and terrain/terrace joins remain estimates.
geographicProposal.groundContactBasis: Source-terrain views inspected. NativeY0 follows retained standardDEM770.4363m at anchor; the common0.75m church/court plane is an estimated visual datum. Foundations follow the coarse west-to-east slope, and the entrance court retains a level paving plane. Principal mapped20/24 to34m dome intervals and30m bell height are preserved relative to that floor. Both roof-stair flights now end on their respective terrace footprints; precise levels and joins are not surveyed or certified walking surfaces.

scaleBasis: Mapped main/part polygons and principal height intervals supply exterior scale; two inspected roof/facade pictures guide individual shape and roof colors.
geometrySource: Original deterministic exterior geometry; no downloaded meshes or copied photographic textures. Footprint-derived registration includes separately attributed OpenStreetMap evidence.

materialMethod: Canonical shared material graphs bound through molenSurface extras with metric coordinates divided by central repeat meters. Vertex colors provide component tint. Glass retains opaque metallic-roughness PBR; no bitmap texture copies per model.

limitations: Exact-QID outline/current main and selected exterior part polygons control fit. Mapped principal height intervals are preserved; component roles, untagged range/terrace heights, cupola curves, roof stairs, doors, windows, rails and ladder are picture-led approximations.

NativeY0 follows coarse standardDEM770.4363m. The estimated0.75m church/court plane, retaining foundations, terraces and stairs must bridge coarse sloping ground; precise street/church levels and joins are unverified. No surveyed or certified walking collision.

Skyline preserves main compound, unequal domes, square bell/red cap, small front cupola and court, using dark surface belfry panes. District restores lower parts and open belfry arches; street/closeup add recessed front/visible bell panes, sparse inferred secondary surface windows, arch bands, eaves, joined roof stairs and a simplified ladder/cross. Full interiors, Aedicule/chapels, underground StHelena volume, exact sculpture/lettering and separate east police range are excluded.

The two references show different roof conditions; gray metal principal domes and red bell tile follow the newer view, with simplified low-frequency shared surfaces. Surrounding city, visitors and vegetation remain host content. Physical laptop/phone measurements remain pending.
importReason: Preserve unequal dome/tower silhouette, irregular mapped ranges, arched facade and open court in four independently authored browser levels.
